Latham & Watkins advised the arrangers and underwriters on the financing for Stonepeak’s completed acquisition of a 65% stake in Castrol, a global leader in lubricants, from BP. BP retains a 35% minority interest in Castrol.

With Stonepeak’s backing and continued support from BP, Castrol will build on its position as one of the world’s largest providers of mission-critical lubricants and thermal management fluids to consumer automotive, commercial, and industrial end markets. The new ownership structure gives Castrol greater financial and operational flexibility, allowing the business to accelerate growth across its existing footprint and into adjacent markets, backed by the brand’s technology, customer relationships, and global reach.

Canada Pension Plan Investment Board is also investing in support of the transaction as an indirect minority holder.

The Latham team was led by partners Keith Halverstam, Alfred Xue, Jennifer Engelhardt, Joydeep Choudhuri, Matthew Schneider, Kelly Egers, Danielle Brown, Stelios Saffos, Dan Seale, Senet Bischoff, Conray Tseng, Josh Holt, Nicole Fanjul, Victor Ludwig, John Lister, Hai Pham, and Tracy Liu, and counsel Gemma Mootoo Rajah, with associates Oscar Lopez, Simba Gonondo, Carlos Ibarguengoitia, Duan Xu, Kristin Tesi, Valera Bamgbala, Amish Magdani, Sophia Premji, Abdullah Khan, Ivan Alaev, Isabella Pazaryna, and Jade Lee, with assistance from Connor Adams, Molly Mitchell, April Yoon, and Dorian Refloc’h. Tax advice was provided by partners Karl Mah and Bora Bozkurt, with associates Lina Le Roux and Sam Yang.
